Meet the Owner

Marcus Webb.
Clean Is the Standard.

I started ClearForce Pro because I grew up watching properties get dirtier every year while nobody did anything about it. Algae on the driveway. Green siding. Blackened fences. Most people don't realise how fast it can be fixed.

Seven years and 600 jobs later, I run commercial-grade equipment — not rental-store machines — and I know exactly how much pressure each surface can take without damage. When I leave, the difference is obvious. That is the only standard I work to.

Warning Signs

Your Property
Is Telling You Something.

These are signs surfaces need professional attention. The longer you wait, the harder — and more expensive — the fix becomes.

Green or Black Streaks

Algae and mould are actively breaking down concrete, siding, and wood. What looks cosmetic is structural damage in slow motion.

Slippery Paths or Driveways

A slippery surface is algae-covered concrete waiting to cause an injury. This is a liability issue, not just an eyesore.

Faded or Grey Siding

Siding that lost its colour is coated in an invisible mould film. A professional wash restores colour without repainting.

Oil Stains on Concrete

Vehicle oil penetrates deeper every month. Early treatment lifts them clean. Old stains require multiple passes and cost more.

Rotting Deck Boards

Decks not regularly cleaned retain moisture and rot underneath. Caught early — a few hundred dollars. Left alone — full replacement.

Your Neighbours Notice

When your property looks darker or greener than the houses next door, it has been overdue for a clean for some time already.
